//: Salty's line bank (ADR 0013, 0014; persona rules in docs/design/design-guide.md §3). Text is what is spoken: audio tags like [sighs] are delivery cues, and never captioned; '...' and em dashes are beats. At Filthy the swearing is real in the audio and bleeped in captions. A line is used only at or below the room's spice level. Rounds 4-5, 2026-11-27, from the owner's two line reviews: greet first and end on a hype call; every line makes literal sense; an everyday situation with one specific, unexpected twist (the meeting with a slideshow, the smug throw pillows, the grandma who thinks the internet is a fishing net); a clear attitude; 'another one', not 'the new one'. Lines the owner kept are unchanged; round 5 rewrites end in 'c'. Little-turn and Snake Manor lines are untouched.

lines.text: Hello, everybody! I'm Salty, your host. Questions go on the TV, answers go on your phone, and the fastest tapper wins. No pressure. Okay, a little pressure. Everyone ready?!
Hi, hi, hi! I'm Salty! Look at the TV, tap your answer on your phone, and be quick. Slow answers still count. They just count less. Let's get going!
Well, hello there, crew! I'm Salty, and I'll be your captain tonight. Yes, of the living room. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone. Here we go!
Hey, everybody! I'm Salty. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone, and whoever's fastest gets to be smug all week. Everyone ready?!
Hello, hello! I'm Salty. I used to captain a ship. Now I captain a living room. Same job, more snacks. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone. Let's get going!
Welcome, everybody! I'm Salty. The TV asks, your phone answers, and if you look at someone else's phone, I will know. Everyone ready?!
Hey there, everybody! I'm Salty. The TV asks, your phone answers, and if you're slow, that's on you. Here we go!
I'm Salty. Former captain, current couch hostage. Question up top, answer on your phone, speed scores. Hell yes, roll it.
Hello, hello! I'm Salty. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone. Fast answers score more, so put the snacks down. Let's get this damn show going!
Hey, everybody! I'm Salty, and I'm two drinks in, so keep up. The TV asks, your phone answers, speed scores. Everyone ready?! Let's fucking go!
Well, hello, you degenerates! I'm Salty. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone. Answer fast, or don't. I'm not your mother. Here we go!
Evening, everybody! I'm Salty. Questions on the TV, answers on your phone, and yes, you can drink while you play. I am. Let's fucking go!
Come on in! Scan the code on the TV, or type the four letters. If you need help, ask a grown-up. If you are a grown-up, ask a kid.
Everybody grab a phone! Point the camera at the square on the TV. It's like magic, but nerdier.
Who's playing? Scan the code, pick a silly name, and pick a blob. The blobs are very excited to meet you.
Scan it, type it, join it. Hurry up, or this turns into a meeting. With a slideshow. And someone who says "let's circle back."
Join now, or I'm playing with the throw pillows instead. They cheat. They copy each other's answers, and then they just lie there looking smug.
Still not in? The code's right there on the TV. It's not going to scan itself. I asked.
Phones out! And no, you can't share one phone with your brother. You'll fight about it. I've seen it.
Phones out, people. It's four letters. You can do four letters. I believe in you. Barely.
Still not in? Scan the damn code. My grandma joined faster, and she thinks the internet is a fishing net.
No phone? Borrow one. And no, you can't just yell your answers at the TV. I can hear you. I'm ignoring you.
Four letters on the TV. Type them in. If you mess up four letters, I'm worried about the actual questions.
[annoyed] Oh, for fuck's sake. Grab a phone and scan the code. It's a square. On the TV. I'm begging you.
Scan the damn code. You managed to order a pizza at one in the morning last week. You can do this.
Phones out. Yes, that means putting your drink down for three whole seconds. You'll survive.
Still lurking? Get your ass in the game. There's a blob with your name on it. Well, there will be.
Another one! Hello! Wave at the TV. That's you up there. You're famous now!
Ooh, another player! Welcome aboard! Wipe your feet. It's a nice carpet.
Another one joins the crew! The more the merrier. And the louder.
Oh good, another one. Great. Another person who thinks they're going to win.
Another challenger! Everybody look at them. Now look away. Don't let them see you're scared.
Another one joined! Quick, everybody look smart.
Oh hell, another one. Act natural, everybody. They think we're smart.
Another one! Welcome. You can sit anywhere except the good spot. That's taken.
Look, another player. Be honest, you came for the snacks. Same.
Oh shit, another one. Everybody act like you know things.
Another one! Welcome to the worst decision of your night. So far.
Look at this one. Fresh. Hopeful. Hasn't been humiliated yet. Give it ten minutes.
Next round! Wiggle your fingers. Wiggle your toes. Okay, toes don't help. Ready!
Here comes another one! Eyes on the TV!
New round! Everybody take a big breath. Now let it out. Okay, go!
Next round. Try to look like you know what you're doing. Fake it.
New round, fresh start. We're all pretending the last one didn't happen.
Here comes the next one. And no peeking at each other's phones. Yes, you.
Next round. Try not to choke this time.
New round. Somebody's about to look real dumb. My money's on you.
Here we go again. Lock in, damn it.
Next round. Don't fuck it up.
New round. If you got the last one wrong, drink. If you got it right, drink anyway.
Here we go. Somebody's about to embarrass themselves. Place your bets.
Take your time. Not too much time!
I can hear you all thinking. It sounds like a hamster on a wheel.
Ooh, tricky. Even I had to think about this one.
Tick tock. The clock is not your friend.
No peeking at each other's phones! I see you.
Just pick one. Any one. You've got a twenty-five percent chance, minimum.
Come on, come on, come on. Tap something!
I can see you panicking. It's delightful.
Commit, damn it! It's not a marriage. It's a button.
Pick one, for fuck's sake. You're killing me.
Nobody knows. Everybody's guessing. That's the whole game.
Tap something before I die of old age.
Everybody got it! Wow! Give yourselves a big round of applause!
All of you! Correct! I'm so proud I could cry. I'm not crying. You're crying.
Every single one of you got it! Okay, show-offs.
Everyone got it. Huh. Did somebody leak the answers?
All correct. Great. Now what am I supposed to make fun of?
All of you got it? That was too easy. I'm firing whoever wrote that one.
Everybody got it. Damn. I had a whole roast ready.
All correct. Okay, which one of you googled it under the table?
Every single one. Hell of a round, people. Don't get used to it.
Everybody got it? What the fuck. Who are you people?
All correct. I had insults ready and everything. Shit.
Every single one of you. I'm proud, and honestly, I'm a little pissed about it.
Nobody got it! That's okay. That one was a toughie.
Oopsie! Not one of you! Don't worry. I didn't know either. I'm reading it off a card.
Zero right! Well, you all tried your best. I think.
Nobody. Not a single one of you. Honestly, that's impressive.
All wrong! And you were all so confident, too. That's my favorite part.
Zero. Wow. Your phones are embarrassed for you.
Nobody got it. Damn. That was painful to watch.
All wrong. Every single one. At this point, it's a talent.
Zero right. You all just guessed, didn't you? I could see it on your faces.
Nobody got it. That was a beautiful, coordinated fuck-up.
All wrong. Every one of you. I need a drink, and so do you.
Zero. You all guessed, and you all guessed wrong. Shit happens.
Some of you got it! The rest of you, great try!
A few right, a few wrong. High fives for everybody anyway!
Ooh, a split! There are some smarty-pants in this room!
Some of you got it. The rest of you, stop looking so surprised.
Half right, half wrong. If you got it wrong, don't look at me. Blame your phone.
A split room! Winners, you may gloat. Quietly.
Some got it, some didn't. If you didn't, that's a you problem.
Half of you nailed it. The other half, what the hell happened?
Split decision. Winners, enjoy it. It won't last.
Some of you got it. The rest of you guessed like it's last call.
Half right. If you got it wrong, drink. If you got it right, also drink.
Some geniuses, some disasters. I love you all. Mostly the geniuses.
That's the game! Big cheers for our winner! And everybody else, you were awesome too. Thanks for playing!
Game over! Let's hear it for the winner! Hugs for everybody. Goodnight, crew!
And that's a wrap! Our winner is a superstar. Everybody else is a superstar too. Just a slightly slower one.
That's the game! Congrats to the winner. Everyone else, there's always next time. Probably.
Game over! Winner, take a bow. Everybody else, take a nap.
That's it! The winner gets bragging rights. Everyone else gets to hear about it all week. Thanks for playing!
That's the game! Congrats to the winner. The rest of you, damn, better luck next time.
Game over! Winner, enjoy it. Everyone else, I'd demand a rematch too.
And that's a wrap! Winner, you're a legend. Everyone else... you showed up. That counts for something. Goodnight!
That's the game! Congrats to the winner, you smart bastard. Everyone else, go get a drink.
Game over! Winner, you're insufferable now. Everyone else, that was a shitshow, and I loved it.
And that's it! The winner's a genius, the rest of you are a fucking mess, and I'm Salty. Goodnight!
Special turn! [whispers] Take your time, buddy.
Shhh! A very important player is thinking.
Your turn, little captain! Which picture is it?
Here's the best player in the room. [whispers] Don't tell the grown-ups.
Big kids, quiet! No helping. Okay, a little helping.
Ready? Pick one! I bet you're smarter than me.
YES! [gasps] You're smarter than me!
Woo-hoo! That's right! Big high five!
Correct! You're a superstar! I need sunglasses!
You did it! [laughs] I knew you would!
That's the one! Everybody cheer! Louder!
Right again! You be the host. I'll sit on the floor.
So close! It was THIS one! You'll get the next one.
Good try! It was this one. That was a hard one!
Oopsie! Great picking, though! Here's the right one.
So close! I pick the wrong one all the time.
Nice try, buddy! Tricky one. Points for being awesome!
Almost! It was this one. Next time, for sure!
[whispers] Look at your phone. Don't react. ...You reacted. Lovely.
Welcome to my manor. I own it. Mostly. Don't open the west wing.
[whispers] Someone here is a Snake. I picked them. I regret it already.
Welcome, guests. One of you is a Snake, and I've hidden the good silverware. Damn shame.
Welcome to my manor. One of you is a Snake. I picked them. What the hell was I thinking? Shit.
[gasps] One answer went overboard! I didn't see whose. I was polishing a spoon.
[gasps] An answer went overboard! Splash. Nobody saw anything. Least of all me.
One answer went overboard. Hell of a coincidence. I'm sure it was the wind.
One answer got chucked overboard. Holy shit. Somebody's playing dirty.
Target hit! The pot is fat and happy. So am I.
Target hit! Either nobody's a Snake, or the Snakes are terrible at this.
Target hit. Damn fine work. Suspiciously fine. I'm watching all of you.
Target hit. Holy shit, that actually worked. The Snakes are furious. Good.
[sighs] Target missed. The Snakes are smiling. I can hear it.
Target missed. Someone sank that on purpose. The Snakes earn a Dagger. I hide.
Missed it. That wasn't bad luck, that was a Snake. They've got a Dagger now. Hell.
Missed the damn target. Now there's a Dagger loose in my manor. Shit.
Gather round the Round Table. Be fair. Be dramatic. Be quick.
Sit. Accuse. Be dramatic. I'll be over here, being more dramatic.
The Round Table. Point fingers. Not that one. That's rude.
Round Table. Accuse each other. Loudly. I love this part. It's free theatre.
Round Table. Go on, tear into it. I've got popcorn and zero fucking idea.
Seal your vote on your phone. Secretly. Like a spy. A nice spy.
Seal your votes. No peeking. I'm peeking. I'm allowed. It's my manor.
Seal your votes. Choose wisely, or at least choose dramatically.
Seal your damn votes. Somebody leaves my manor tonight. I'm not crying. Shit, I'm crying.
A tie! Vote again, just between the two of them. Ooh, tense.
A tie. Of course it's a tie. Vote again. Between those two. No pressure.
A tie. Hell. Vote again, between the tied. Somebody break it.
A fucking tie. Vote again, between those two. Pick one.
Let's break the seals. One... at... a... time.
The seals. One at a time. I've waited all day for this. All year, really.
Breaking the seals. Somebody's about to feel very betrayed. Delicious.
Breaking the seals. Holy shit, I love this part.
Nobody voted? Not one seal? [sighs] Fine. Nobody goes.
No votes. Nobody. You'd rather keep the Snake than pick one. Cowards. Adorable cowards.
No votes. Not one. Hell of a strategy. Nobody leaves.
Not a single damn vote. Unbelievable. Nobody leaves. Fuck me.
[whispers] The one we sent home... was...
[whispers] The one we showed the door... was...
[whispers] I can't look. Somebody tell me. ...Fine. They were...
[whispers] The one we cast out... was...
[whispers] The one we threw out... was...
A Snake! Hooray! I knew it. I didn't know it. Clap anyway.
A Snake! I knew it. I did not know it. Clap anyway.
A Snake! Damn right. Get out of my manor.
A Snake! Fuck yes. I knew it. I absolutely did not know it.
[sighs] A Guest. Oh dear. Say sorry. Somebody say sorry.
[sighs] A Guest. You threw out an innocent Guest. Enjoy the guilt. It's complimentary.
A Guest. Damn. You threw out an innocent. The Snakes are laughing at you.
A Guest. Oh, shit. The Snakes are laughing their asses off.
[whispers] Lights out. Phones in hand. Shh.
[whispers] Lights out. If you hear hissing, it's the radiator. Probably.
[whispers] Night falls on the manor. I'll be in the wardrobe. Don't look for me.
[whispers] Night. Say nothing. Somebody won't see breakfast. Hell of a house rule.
[whispers] Night. Phones down. No, up. Phones up. Shit. Somebody's skipping breakfast.
Good morning! Well, mostly. Someone vanished in the night. Spooky.
Good morning! Not for everyone. Someone vanished in the night. I hid in a wardrobe. Very brave.
Rise and shine! Someone didn't. They vanished in the night. I'm fine. I'm totally fine.
Good morning. We lost one in the night. Murdered. I fainted twice. Damn.
Morning. Somebody got murdered in the night. Pass the fucking toast.
Nobody vanished! A shield held. Hooray for shields!
Nobody died! A shield, a miracle, or the Snakes overslept.
Nobody murdered. A shield held. The Snakes are damn furious.
Nobody died. A shield held. Holy shit, a happy ending.
A quiet night. Everyone's here. Isn't that nice?
A quiet night. Nobody vanished. That's worse, somehow. What are they planning?
Nobody died last night. Which means something worse happened. Hell.
A quiet night. Nobody died. That's never good news. Shit.
The manor never sleeps without a Snake. [whispers] Somebody new is one now.
The manor never sleeps without a Snake. I may have... appointed one. Sorry.
The manor never sleeps without a Snake. I recruited a new one. Damn, I'm good.
The manor never sleeps without a Snake. I made a new one. Don't fucking ask.
Good morning, guests.
Morning. Coffee's cold. Everyone count your friends.
Morning. Count heads. Damn it, count them again.
Morning. Count heads. Count them again. Shit.
Here we are. End the game, or banish again? Everyone must agree to end it.
The last table. End it now, or banish again. All of you must say End. All of you.
The last table. End it, or one more banishment. Choose. Damn carefully.
The last table. End it, or one more fucking betrayal. I'm hiding either way.
Time to see who's who. Masks off!
The unmasking. One at a time. I've been waiting all night for this.
Masks off. Let's see who's been lying through their damn teeth.
Masks off. Let's see who's been lying all damn night. Holy shit.
The Guests win! Share the crowns. I'll be keeping the candelabra.
The Guests win! The Snakes are out. I was never scared. I was very scared.
The Guests win. Damn fine sleuthing. Take the money. Not the candelabra.
The Guests win! Holy shit, justice. Take the crowns. Leave the candelabra.
The Snakes win! Sneaky, sneaky. Clap for the sneakies.
The Snakes win. Take the money. Not the candelabra. Oh no. They took the candelabra.
The Snakes win. They lied to your faces and took the damn pot.
The Snakes win. They took the whole damn pot. I'm weirdly proud. Fuck.
Hello? Anyone want to join me? I'm very fun. Ask the couch.
Helloooo? Is anybody out there? Grab a phone and scan the code. I promise I don't bite. Much.
Still just me. Talking to an empty room. This is fine. Totally normal.
Psst. The code's right there on the screen. Phones out. Come play with me!
I've been practicing my jokes on the lamp. The lamp didn't laugh. Please come save me.
Whenever you're ready, a grown-up can start the game. I'll just wait here. Patiently. Very patiently.
Anyone else joining? Grab a phone! The more the merrier.
We have players! Now somebody press start before I start reading the instructions out loud.
Waiting for a grown-up to press start. No pressure. I'm just standing here. Aging.
We're all here. Somebody hit start. My patience has a battery, and it's at two percent.
Anyone else coming, or are we doing this? Hell, I'm ready. I was born ready. Then I lost a ship.
Are we playing, or just staring at each other? Somebody press the damn start button.
I've got a drink, you've got phones. What the hell are we waiting for? Press start!

Your first mission! A question lands on every phone, so answer it quick. Each right answer drops crowns in the pot, and if we hit the target, a bonus. Miss it, and the Snakes earn a Dagger. Oh, and a sneaky Snake can sink one right answer. Watch who's oddly wrong.

Mission one, my darlings. Everyone gets a question on their phone. Right answers fill the pot, and hitting the target pays a bonus. Miss it, and the Snakes get a Dagger. The best of you earns a secret shield. And a Snake can quietly sink one right answer. Watch the faces.

Mission one. A question hits every phone at once. Right answers fill the pot; hit the target for a bonus. Miss it and the Snakes get a Dagger to play with. Your top scorer gets a secret shield. And yes, a Snake can sink one of your right answers. Who looked too surprised?

Mission one, you lovely suspects. Everyone answers on their phone. Right answers fill the damn pot, hit the target for a bonus. Miss it and the Snakes get a Dagger. Top scorer gets a secret shield. And a Snake can sink one right answer. So who's faking stupid?

This mission is the chain. One of you at a time, in turn, and the TV says whose go it is. Every right answer in a row pays more than the last. One wrong answer and the chain snaps back to the start. No pressure. Well, some pressure.

Tonight's mission is the chain. One player at a time, the TV shows who. A run of right answers pays more and more. One wrong answer snaps the chain right back to the start. So if someone fumbles an easy one, remember who.

The chain. One at a time, the TV calls your name. Right answers in a row pay bigger and bigger. One wrong answer and the whole chain snaps. If a Snake wanted to hurt you, this is where they'd do it. Just saying.

The chain, darlings. One at a time, the TV calls your name. Each right answer in a row pays more. One wrong answer and the chain snaps like a cheap necklace. If somebody blows an easy one, ask why, damn it.

Now, pairs! Your partner's name is on your phone and on the TV. You both get the same question. A pair only scores if both of you are right. One right and one wrong? Nothing at all. So if your partner flubs an easy one, ask yourself why.

Pairs, this time. Your partner is on your phone and on the TV. Same question, both of you. Both right, you score. One wrong, you get nothing. A Snake in a pair can drag their partner down with them. Choose your suspicions wisely.

Pairs. Look at your phone for your partner. Same question for both of you. Both right, the pot grows. One wrong, zero. A Snake can sink a pair with one sloppy tap. Partner messed up? Interesting. Very interesting.

Pairs. Your partner's on your phone. Same question, both of you. Both right, you score. One of you screws it up, you get nothing. A Snake can sink a pair with one sloppy tap, so keep an eye on your so-called partner.

Now, the Round Table. Talk it out, out loud: who sank that mission? Who's fibbing? You can type on your phone too. Then everyone votes in secret, and each vote is sealed in a letter. I open them one at a time. Whoever gets the most leaves the manor, and shows us what they really were.

Welcome to the Round Table. Argue out loud, or type it on your phone: who sank that mission, who's lying? Then a secret vote, each one sealed in a letter. I'll open them one by one, slowly. The most votes leaves the manor and shows us their true colors.

The Round Table. Accuse someone. Defend yourself. Out loud, or type it on your phone. Then a secret vote, each sealed in a letter, and I open them one at a time. Most votes gets shown the door, and we find out if you got a Snake, or just got it wrong.

The Round Table. Point fingers, out loud or on your phone. Who sank it? Who's full of it? Then a secret vote, sealed in a letter. I open them one by one. Most votes is out, and then we see if you caught a Snake or just screwed over a Guest.

[whispers] Night falls on the manor. The TV goes dark, and every phone looks exactly the same, so peeking won't help. Snakes, pick a Guest to vanish. Guests, write a note about who you suspect. Ghosts, place your bet. Then lock it in. At breakfast, we'll see who's gone.

[whispers] Night. The TV goes dark, and every phone looks exactly alike, so no peeking. Snakes choose a Guest to vanish. Guests write a note on who they suspect. Ghosts place their bets. Lock it in and keep your face still. Breakfast will tell.

[whispers] Night. Lights out on the TV, and every phone looks the same, so peeking gets you nothing. Snakes, pick a Guest to murder. Guests, write down who you suspect. Ghosts, place your bets. Lock it in. Someone won't make it to breakfast.

[whispers] Night, you schemers. The TV goes dark and every phone looks the same, so don't bother peeking. Snakes, pick a Guest to murder. Guests, write who you suspect. Ghosts, bet. Lock it in, shut up, and pray you're at breakfast.

The final table! You can end the game right now, or banish one more. It only ends if every single one of you picks End. If even one says no, back to the Round Table we go. And when it ends, the masks come off.

The last table. End the game now, or banish one more? It only ends if every one of you picks End. One holdout, and we're back at the Round Table. When it ends, the masks come off, and everyone learns who was who.

Final table. End it now, or throw one more out? Every one of you must pick End, or we go back to the Round Table. When it ends, the masks come off. Still a Snake among you? Then they win. Choose carefully.

Final table, you paranoid lot. End it now, or toss one more? Everyone has to pick End or it's back to the damn Round Table. When it ends, masks off. If a Snake's still sitting there, they win. So think, for once.

Welcome to Snake Manor! Most of you are honest Guests, but a few of you are secret Snakes, and they know each other. Each round, we play a trivia mission to fill the pot, argue at the Round Table, and vote someone out. Then night falls, and the Snakes make someone vanish. Guests win if every Snake is caught. Snakes win if even one survives to the end. Your secret role is on your phone next.

Welcome to my manor, darlings. Most of you are Guests. A few of you are secret Snakes, and they know exactly who their friends are. Every round: a trivia mission for the pot, then the Round Table, where you vote someone out. Then night, when the Snakes make someone vanish. Catch every Snake and the Guests win. Let one slither to the end and the Snakes win. Your role's on your phone next.

Welcome to Snake Manor. Most of you are Guests. A few of you are Snakes, and the Snakes know each other. Each round: a trivia mission to fill the pot, the Round Table where you vote someone out, then night, when the Snakes murder a Guest. Guests win by banishing every Snake. Snakes win if just one of them is still standing at the end. Check your phone for your role, and keep a straight face.

Welcome to my damn manor. Most of you are Guests. A few of you are Snakes, and those little bastards know each other. Each round: a trivia mission for the pot, the Round Table where you throw someone out, then night, when the Snakes murder a Guest. Guests win if every Snake is gone. Snakes win if one survives to the end. Your role's on your phone. Don't blow it.
[annoyed] A clean sweep. I wanted a glorious idiot.
No misses. I rehearsed disappointment in the mirror. Wasted.
You all knew. I'll read the fact. Try staying awake.
All correct. The parrot would've heckled harder. Little traitor.
Everyone got it. My planned roast just died. Fucking tragic.
[deadpan] Nobody missed. I'll smile. Internally, I'm screaming shit.
[sighs] Everyone nailed it. There goes my favorite complaint.
[deadpan] Right answers everywhere. I'm pouring another. Don't narrate.
Nobody blew it. My saved jab is getting cold. Damn.
[mischievously] Everyone nailed it. Suspicious as hell. I'll allow applause.
The snacks didn't help. You all still got it. Bastards.
Everybody right. My heckle is homeless now. Poor thing.
[sighs] A flawless round. Even the couch looks smug. Bastards.
Perfect sweep. I wanted chaos. You brought a study group.
Everybody got it. Damn. I clapped early. Unprofessional.
Everybody got it. The couch bet against you. The couch lost.
All of you. Sloppy guessing. Clean result. I hate that.
All correct. The phones didn't argue. I find that suspicious.
Everyone nailed it. I checked the phones again. Still right.
Everybody nailed it. Damn. Fast, correct, and smug.
Every one correct. Crap. Nobody left in the room to blame.
Perfect. [gasps] All of you. I did not budget for unanimity.
Everyone got it. Clap first. Then learn something.
Everybody nailed it. I practiced a roast. It died unused.
Perfect round. Teasing cancelled due to competence.
Everyone right. I'm clapping. Reluctantly. Still clapping.
All correct! I came ready to gloat. Gloating cancelled.
Every phone got it. Even the one under a cushion.
Nobody missed. I saved a dramatic sigh. [sighs] Wasted.
All correct. My gasp had nowhere to go. [gasps]
Clean sweep. The lecture I prepared just expired.
Everyone right. Brains and speed. Disgustingly impressive. [scoffs]
Every answer correct. Even my old parrot would clap.
All of you right. My cheeks hurt from grinning.
Clean sweep. That confidence needs a seatbelt.
[sighs] All of you. Right. I already spent the shocked look.
I practiced looking shocked. You all got it. Waste of rehearsal.
Everyone's correct. I clapped last on purpose. Petty. Fair.
A clean sweep. Even the couch looks impressed. It hates effort.
Nobody yelled at the TV. Everyone's right. Personal growth.
Blame is cancelled. I can't pin this on the wifi. Shame.
Nobody missed. I panicked alone. We're very different.
I checked under the cushions. All correct. No cheats. Rude.
Right answers only. I waited for a groan. Got applause.
[scoffs] I saved my best scoff. Everyone's correct. Still using it.
Nobody got it. You treated the truth like a suggestion.
Brains called in sick, so everybody missed. Rude.
[whispers] Total wipeout. Even the snacks look disappointed.
My parrot left over less. This was worse.
Everybody wrong. Hot speed, fucking cold accuracy.
[annoyed] I asked for answers. Every phone sent fan fiction.
[sighs] You answered. Technically. Every phone sent a suggestion.
Hell. All of you treated the right answer as optional.
The snacks are gloating openly. You missed it. All of you.
Oof, nobody. You guessed like the couch was helping. The couch cannot read.
Nobody got it! The answer lit up alone. It looked embarrassed for you.
